Ducks at Golden Knights projected lineups

away.summary: The Vegas Golden Knights are coming off a 5-2 win against the Chicago Blackhawks in their season opener. Adin Hill is confirmed to start in goal, with no injured players listed. The lineup is expected to remain largely unchanged from the opener, with Trevor Connelly making his NHL debut and Jack Eichel continuing his strong point production.

home.summary: The Vancouver Canucks are coming off a 4-1 win against the Calgary Flames. Kevin Lankinen is confirmed to start in goal after Merilainen made 23 saves in his first start. Jake DeBrusk is expected to miss a second straight game with illness and is day to day, while Thatcher Demko and Filip Chytil are listed as injured.
